classification_limitations: User-authorized existing tracked universe; not verified historical or current VN100 membership.
No provider requests, source security-type verification, venue verification, stable security/issuer-ID verification or ticker-history verification.
Stored presence does not establish current listing, trading, complete price coverage or eligible ADX observations.
Ticker-only identity: unresolved changes/reuse require reason-coded observations; never silently substitute securities.
Cohort freeze does not qualify data; DATA_BLOCKED remains for qualified/controlled research.
label: FIXED_COHORT_V1 / EXISTING_TRACKED_UNIVERSE
membership_hash_definition: SHA256 of cohort_v1_tickers.txt; UTF-8 without BOM, one exact ticker per line, ascending lexical order, LF line endings including final LF. Order is serialization only, not selection ranking.

membership_policy.cohort_v2: New additions belong to a separately identified, explicitly approved V2 with its own manifest, hash and enrollment; never overwrite or backfill V1 membership.
membership_policy.missing_or_delisted: Retain original V1 ticker; keep each expected date/member record and attributable reason; no silent replacement.
membership_policy.operational_watchlist: Separately versioned effective-dated operational list with parent version/hash, own hash, additions/removals and reasons.
membership_policy.research_v1: All 100 tickers retained for the entire declared enrollment; additions/removals in operational watchlist do not affect V1.
membership_policy.ticker_changes: Preserve original V1 record and hash. Alias mapping only with attributable continuity evidence; unresolved identity remains unavailable.

reader_compatibility.requirements: Use V1 ticker file with explicit isolated snapshot and declared sessions; never rebuild research membership from live VN100 or date-dependent coverage.
reader_compatibility.verification: Static production interface inspection only; no prices loaded and no ADX/evaluation executed.

source.connection: file URI mode=ro&immutable=1; query_only=ON; no WAL/SHM/journal present before or after
source.database_is_not_preserved_here: Only cohort membership is frozen; source database SHA binds extraction vintage, not future database contents.
source.extraction_sql: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM prices WHERE symbol <> 'VNINDEX' ORDER BY symbol
source.kind: existing local market database, prices.symbol distinct stored universe

study_scope.enrollment_duration: 12 calendar months plus exact H10 maturity tail
study_scope.freeze_scope: Membership only; no protocol activation or independently preregistered historical selection claim.
